subject: mathematics
content: The foot of perpendicular from the origin $\mathrm{O}$ to a plane $\mathrm{P}$ which meets the co-ordinate axes at the points $\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}, \mathrm{C}$ is $(2, \mathrm{a}, 4), \mathrm{a} \in \mathrm{N}$. If the volume of the tetrahedron $\mathrm{OABC}$ is 144 unit$^{3}$, then which of the following points is NOT on P ?
